title: 50 Days, 12B Tokens: Making Cloudfall with Opus 5.5
author: CloudFallAndi
selftext:
I started this project shortly after 5.5 came out, mostly to see how good a game I could make with it. As you all probably know, 5.5 is pretty amazing at this stuff. ;)

After a lot of hours designing, testing, and iterating, I’m genuinely happy with how the game has turned out. So far, only my kids and I have played it, so I’d love to hear what other people think.

Cloudfall is my take on the survivors-like genre, mixing perk stacking with fast-paced bullet hell action. You play as AI agents fighting to take down an evil AI and its forces. The playtest includes the full story mode, with all nine weapons finished and playable.

Next in Line: Massive Endgame Mode on a gigantic Mega-Map with Buildings And Bases to take over in a Time Trial Stlye Escalation Mode, a Cosmetics / Achivement System.

Get the playtest here: [https://d4strm.itch.io/cloudfall](https://d4strm.itch.io/cloudfall)

Most Of the Work (Roughly 60%) was made with Opus 5.5 the Rest with Sonnet 5.5. Music is made with ElevenLabs based on Opus Prompts. Im using the Default Claude Desktop App on 2 Pro Accounts, with no extra skills or stuff like that. Workflow wise im Using extensive MD Files for Documenting and Orchistrating and try to keep session very small to save on Usage.

comments.author: Frosty-Breath-81
comments.body:
Gotta get rid of that AI-ass name, "Cloudfall". Trailer is also extremely obvious AI... "9 weapons" isn't an interesting or necessary text to have. Take a look at game trailers before AI to get a better feel for how they should be. Should pretty much get rid of all the text tbh.

Looks fun otherwise. You should make it playable thru browser on itch.io or a steam demo, most people (including me), aren't going to download a stranger's file just to try.
